name: How do I choose which pre-listing improvements are necessary for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose which pre-listing improvements are necessary for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: To choose necessary pre-listing improvements, start with a professional home evaluation. Your Kelby Contreras agent can walk through your property with a buyer's eye, identifying critical repairs or cosmetic updates that will enhance appeal and value. Consider elements like curb appeal, functionality of major systems, and current design trends. This preparation helps prioritize projects that address potential buyer concerns or highlight your home's best features, avoiding unnecessary expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin by consulting a real estate agent for a professional home evaluation. They can help identify critical repairs and cosmetic updates to enhance appeal and value, guiding your choices.
